problem.title: Net Delivery Adjustment per Restaurant
problem.prompt: A food delivery platform tracks financial adjustments made to restaurants' weekly payout balances. Each adjustment is either a `credit` (money added to the restaurant's balance, due to tip corrections or bonus payouts) or a `debit` (money deducted, due to chargebacks or penalty fees). Write a query that computes the **net adjustment amount** for each restaurant over the reporting period. A `credit` contributes POSITIVELY to the net; a `debit` contributes NEGATIVELY. The output column should be named `net_adjustment` and may be negative (indicating the restaurant had a net loss). Include all restaurants that have at least one adjustment record. Return columns `restaurant_id` and `net_adjustment`, ordered by `restaurant_id` ascending.
problem.schema_ddl: CREATE TABLE payout_adjustments (adjustment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, restaurant_id INT NOT NULL, adjustment_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, adjustment_date DATE NOT NULL);

composite_moves: signed_aggregate pivot: SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) grouped by restaurant_id

hints: You need to separate credits from debits and combine them into a single number per restaurant.
Use CASE expressions inside a SUM to handle each adjustment_type differently—one adds, one subtracts.
Group by restaurant_id and compute SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END).
problem.answer_key: SELECT restaurant_id, SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_adjustment FROM payout_adjustments GROUP BY restaurant_id ORDER BY restaurant_id;

_meta.scenario: a food delivery service tracking order completion and delivery time

user_solution:
/*
pivot then calculate
 */
SELECT
    restaurant_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END -
        CASE WHEN adjustment_type = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_adjustment
FROM payout_adjustments
GROUP BY restaurant_id
ORDER BY restaurant_id;
